To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the chlorhexidine and flavonoids can inhibit SARS CoV2 3CLpro activity.
the flavonoids and CHX have a strong inhibitory effect on SARS CoVs main protease, especially, Kaempferide 3 rutinosid, Rutin, and Quercetin 2 beta D glucosid.
the CHX, Kaemperfol 3 rutinosid, rutin, Quercetn 3 beta D glukozid and Isobavakalcon have a potential effect on the SARS Co V 2 main proteases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of potential antiviral agents against SARS CoV2 main protease.
the evaluation of the effects of CHX and flavones on SARS Co V 2 main proteases.
a molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation study of the SARS Co V-2 main protease with chlorhexidine and flavonoids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the current study provides a novel insight into the molecular mechanism of CHX and bioflavonoids as potential antiviral agent against the SARS-CoV-2 infection, which could help to guide future clinical trials.
the current research provides a guide for clinical trials of broad spectrum chlorhexidine and bioactive flavanoids in the treatment of the COVID 19 pandemic.
the current study provides to the guide clinical trials for the broad spectrum CHX, bioactive flavonoid compounds to reduce the viral burden of the infection and potentially disease progression.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the flavonoids compounds have a significant effect in the inhibition of SARS CoV2 3CLpro, which is a key protease in the replication process of this coronavirus, and the flavonoids are also more stable in binding with SARS CoV-2 3CL protease than N3, the crystal structure inhibitor of SARS Co V-2 3 CLpro.
CHX, Kaemperol 3 rutin, Rutin, Isobavachalocne and Quercetin 4 glucoside are the most effective compounds against SARS CoV2 main protease.
we have evaluated the potential antiviral activity of CHX and flavanoids compounds against SARS CoV-2 main protease by molecular docking and molecular dynamic simulation methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the compounds which are used in oral health care and have a strong antiviral effect against enveloped virus, can be effective against SARS CoV2, and can be used in the treatment of COVID 19.
the flavonoids compounds and chlorhexidine can be used to prevent and reduce the viral load in the COVID 19 patients.
CHX and flavanoids compounds may be used as antiviral agent for the treatment of COVID-19.
